contexts.name: Reasoning
contexts.description: agent's internal cognitive loop — partitioning bounded contexts, separating concerns, holding alternatives before convergence

contexts.name: Evidence
contexts.description: claims with maturity tags (verified, plausible, assumed, unknown), verification paths, evidence chains

contexts.name: Decision
contexts.description: alternatives compared against explicit characteristics, trade-offs accepted, choose-now-vs-probe gate

contexts.name: Vocabulary
contexts.description: stabilizing terms across bounded contexts via sense cells, risky aliases, bridge notes

contexts.name: Measurement
contexts.description: calibration logs, session observations, experiment configs for causal effect estimation

characteristics.name: context_coverage
characteristics.indicator: how many relevant bounded contexts were partitioned before reasoning

characteristics.name: alternative_diversity
characteristics.indicator: number of genuinely distinct options maintained before selection

characteristics.name: traceability_depth
characteristics.indicator: how many aligned output forms produced per reasoning body

output_forms.content: named frames with meanings and boundaries
decision, alternatives, criteria, evidence gaps, temporal window
term entries with sense cells, risky aliases, bridge notes
prioritized gaps, maturity summary, C.11 gate decision
